extDescription.message: Turn X's media tab, home & likes into an image grid. Like, bookmark & repost without opening posts. Display-only, no automation.

toastSearchUnsupported.message: Actions can't be run directly from search results (press $KEY$ to open the tweet and act there)

toastRelocateFailed.message: Could not re-locate the original post (press $KEY$ to open the tweet and act there)

toastActionButtonNotFound.message: Could not find the action button

toastRepostButtonNotFound.message: Could not find the repost button

toastRepostConfirmNotFound.message: Could not find the repost confirmation button

toastReplyButtonNotFound.message: Could not find the reply button

toastReplyOpenFailed.message: Could not open the reply composer

optHideSidebarLabel.message: Hide the right sidebar while the grid is shown

optHideSidebarDesc2.message: On: hides the sidebar so the grid can use the extra width. A "Search" button appears in the toolbar instead; pressing it shows the sidebar temporarily, just for searching.

optTileActionsLabel.message: Show action buttons when hovering over a tile

optTileActionsDesc.message: Default: on. "♥ / 🔖 / 💬" buttons (like, bookmark, reply) appear at the top right of each image in the grid. Turn this off if you prefer keyboard-only use.

optKeyMoveUp.message: Move up (the ↑ key always works too)

optKeyMoveDown.message: Move down (the ↓ key always works too)

optKeyMoveLeft.message: Move left; previous image in multi-image posts (the ← key always works too)

optKeyMoveRight.message: Move right; next image in multi-image posts (the → key always works too)

optKeyOpenClose.message: Open (zooms a single image directly, opens the list for multiple images) / close · go back one level

optKeySpace.message: In the grid, smoothly scrolls about one screen; in a multi-image list, shows the selected image on its own

optKeyOpenTweet.message: Open the post (in the same tab; going back restores your spot)

optKeyOpenMedia.message: Open the author's page (destination is chosen in Display settings above)

optKeyReply.message: Reply (opens X's reply composer in place; you type and send it yourself as usual)

optKeyRetweet.message: Repost / undo (a plain repost, not a quote; to quote, open the tweet first)

optKeyProfileToMedia.message: On a profile page, go to that account's media page

optKeyNotInterested.message: Open the "•••" menu of the hovered post (while it is open: move within the menu with the up/down keys (default W/S), select with Space, close with the open/close key (default Q))

optKeyGoHome.message: Go back to Home (no new tab; same as clicking the real Home icon in the same tab)

optNoteFixed.message: Space, Esc and the arrow keys are fixed. Everything else is saved automatically when you type a single character into the fields above (duplicates are not allowed).

optNoteBlank1.message: For keys other than the five movement/open-close keys,

optNoteBlank2.message: leaving the field blank means "no key assigned"

optNoteBlank3.message: and that feature will no longer respond to any key (e.g. to prevent accidental reposts if you never repost).

optAboutIntro.message: This extension turns X (formerly Twitter) media, likes, bookmarks and Home into a grid of images you can browse quickly with the keyboard alone. Liking, bookmarking, following and more take a single key. The main features, in order of importance:

optFeat1a.message: Converts media pages, your likes history, bookmarks and Home (with "Images only" on) into a Pinterest-style image grid.

optFeat1b.message: Move the selection with W/A/S/D (or the arrow keys), open/close with Q, and use Space to scroll a screenful or zoom an image.

optFeat1c.message: The number of grid columns can be changed from the toolbar.

optFeat2a.message: On Home and Bookmarks, a button toggles whether posts without images are filtered out and the rest shown as a grid.

optFeat2b.message: Home remembers this per tab ("For you", "Following", ...), separately from Bookmarks.

optFeat3a.message: Click (or press Q) to see every image in the post laid out large from the start. Space enlarges one image further; A/D steps through them.

optFeat4a.message: Buttons in the grid narrow it down to only posts you haven't seen, or only video posts.

optFeat5a.message: Media pages open with photos by default, and a button at the top switches to a videos-only view.

optFeat6a.message: A small card with the avatar, name, bio, follow counts and a follow button is shown at the top of media pages.

optFeat7a.message: Open a post, open the author's media page, like, bookmark, refresh Home, open the menu, or go back to Home — each with a single key.

optFeat7b.message: Even on the normal timeline (without the grid), WASDQ selects posts for the same operations.

optFeat8a.message: The right sidebar can also be shown or hidden (see the settings on the left).

optErrRequired.message: $NAME$ is a required movement/open-close key and cannot be left blank

optErrSpace.message: Space cannot be assigned because it conflicts with the fixed scroll action

optFTargetDesc.message: Default: profile. Choose "Media tab" to jump straight to their photos.

optAccentDesc.message: Default: X's blue. Changes the selection outline, tab underline, buttons, and other accents at once.

optSeenColorDesc.message: Posts you've already seen get this color on the strip under the tile (a marker of how far you've read; recorded when you refresh or navigate away). Default is a theme-matched blue.
